property_summary: For any admissible call to transfer, the reference C either reverts or returns true, and never performs a successful call beyond the first failed external call; the buggy loop with i <= _tos.length indexes out of bounds and reverts on every input, breaking the universal rule that some admissible input makes the call complete and return true.
